senses.gloss: (b. h.) to tremble, be in commotion, rage.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29">Ex. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 68:9">Ps. LXVIII, 9</cite>) <he>ומה אם … ארץ רָעֲשָׁה וכ׳</he> if the earth trembled when he gave life to the world, how much more (will it tremble), when he comes to &c.
<cite ref="Psalms 68:9">Ib.</cite> <he>השמים … רוֹעֲשִׁים</he> heaven and earth tremble.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> (play on <he>יערשיה</he> <cite ref="I Chronicles 8:27">I Chr. VIII, 27</cite>) <he>בשעה … מַרְעִישׁ עולמו וכ׳</he> whenever God caused the world to quake, he remembered the merits of the fathers &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:4">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> <he>להַרְעִישׁ</he>, v. <cite ref="C01193"><he>גָּעַשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>הַרְעִישָׁה</he>, v. <cite ref="A02830"><he>אֲפַרְכֶסֶת</he></cite>. Tanḥ. P’kudé 3, v. <cite ref="T00925"><he>רַעַשׁ</he></cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 132:1">Yalk. Gen. 132</cite> <he>והרעיש עצמו</he>, read: <he>והרפיש</he>, v. <cite ref="T00966"><he>רָפַשׁ</he></cite>.]
